text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — starting a pilot for a graduated soft-cap burst waiver across hosted API customers. This is NOT a permanent pricing change; it's a targeted program to reduce noisy invoices for Spikey Apps during feature launches. :wave:

Omar Reyes: What does "graduated" mean here? free bursts, tiers, time windows?

Maya Chen: Good q. It means small overages are waived up to a threshold, then a modest per-token surcharge applies after that. Thresholds scale with subscription tier and average monthly usage. Example: starter gets a 5% soft cap, scale gets 10%. This is intended to cut customer support noise for spikes.

Priya Patel: FYI finance will still record the usage. Invoice will show a new line item for transparency labeled `soft_cap_burst_credit` with the waived amount and the residual charge if any. No change to committed Reserved/Dedicated contracts.

Omar Reyes: Any changes we need in the rate limiter/runtime? Will fallback rules be affected?

Maya Chen: Runtime unchanged. Rate limits still enforced. This waiver is applied at billing reconciliation only (post-hoc) for hosted API. We will add tagging so we can attribute waived tokens to customers for cost analysis.

Priya Patel: Here is an example invoice snippet (prototype):
```
line_item: usage_generation_tokens
units: 1,234,567
charge: $123.45
line_item: soft_cap_burst_credit
units: -12,345
credit: -$1.23
```
Customers will see both lines; the credit reduces the net charge.

Omar Reyes: Nice. What about telemetry/alerts? Ops wants to avoid masking real capacity issues.

Maya Chen: Good catch — the waiver will be gated behind an anomaly filter. If we detect sustained spikes or TTL breaches we won't apply the waiver and ops will get an alert. Short single-event bursts are what we want to cover.

Priya Patel: Timeline: pilot starts next Monday for 4 weeks. We'll notify all customers who become eligible and include an opt-out link. Billing FAQ and invoice samples will be published to the console docs.

Maya Chen: Action items: Priya to publish invoice samples and FAQ, Omar to add a telemetry tag for waived bursts, Eng to add console flags for customers to preview waived credits in billing UI. I'll follow up with the exact tier mapping doc. :memo:

Billing Bot: Note recorded: pilot soft-cap waiver | start=1855612800 | duration=28d | doc=https://internal.redwood/ops/billing/soft-cap-pilot. Will post summary after first week. :eyes:

Priya Patel: cc @support — please be prepared for inbound tickets about "why did my spike not get waived" and have the checklist: 1) check eligibility window 2) check anomaly filter 3) confirm invoice line `soft_cap_burst_credit`.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — will post the public-facing announcement draft later today for feedback. :thumbsup:
